findings.verbatim: fr renders "this login" as "cet accès" and "session-bound access" as "une autorisation liée à chaque session". The namespace renders login as "connexion" (head_finite_share, not_copied, needs_broker "emprunter des connexions"), so the borrowed object drifts to a vaguer term. Who may borrow (all sessions on the device) and the per-session binding are preserved.
findings.recommendation: Name the login with the namespace term, e.g. "Les sessions sur {device} peuvent emprunter cette connexion avec un accès lié à chaque session."
findings.disposition: not applied: auditors never edit translations; handed to the implementer for one batched remediation or explicit deferral. Nonblocking: no security-consent consequence is reversed or omitted.
